sloka: मत्कथाः प्रचरिष्यन्ति यावल्लोके हरीश्वर ।तावद्रमस्व सुप्रीतो मद्वाक्यमनुपालयन् ।। ७.१०८.३४ ॥
transliteration: matkathāḥ pracariṣyanti yāvalloke harīśvara ।tāvadramasva suprīto madvākyamanupālayan ।। 7.108.34 ॥

translations.english: O chief of monkeys, as long as my stories are current in the world, you shall remain very pleased, obeying my command.
